rules.guard: one side's (hostile to the other side's players only) with ExtraFlags & 0x400 and MinLevel >= 10, or named /\b(Guard|Sentinel|Grunt|Protector|Deathguard|Brave|Watcher|Watchman|Mountaineer|Peacekeeper|Defender|Enforcer|Soldier)\b/ and MinLevel >= 20
rules.service: one side's, not a guard, NpcFlags & 0x419e (quest giver, vendor, flight master, trainer, innkeeper, banker, repair)
rules.hub: single linkage at 60 yd; a cluster with >= 1 guard or >= 4 service NPCs is a hub; hubs of one side within 100 yd are listed as one (a naming merge: their disks unchanged, none added)
rules.name: AreaTable: the capital (Flags_0 & 0x100) at least half the spawns stand in (chunk area or zone map), else the subzone under the centroid, else the most common subzone, else the zone
rules.disks: 50 yd around a guard, 25 yd around a service NPC
